Routines

top source red::make_nb_cube

SST pipeline

red::make_nb_cube, wcfile, clips=clips, cmap_fwhm=cmap_fwhm, fitpref_time=fitpref_time, integer=integer, intensitycorrmethod=intensitycorrmethod, nearest=nearest, noaligncont=noaligncont, nocavitymap=nocavitymap, nocrosstalk=nocrosstalk, noflipping=noflipping [, /nomissing_nans] [, /nopolarimetry], noremove_periodic=noremove_periodic [, /nostretch], notimecor=notimecor, nthreads=nthreads, odir=odir, overwrite=overwrite, redemodulate=redemodulate, tiles=tiles, wbsave=wbsave

Wrapper method for make_nb_cube with or without demodulation.

Together with new methods make_nb_cube_stokes and make_nb_cube_intensity, based on earlier versions of make_nb_cube for CRISP and CHROMIS.

nomissing_nans in optional type=boolean

Do not set missing-data padding to NaN. (Set it to the median of each frame instead.)

nopolarimetry in optional type=boolean

For a polarimetric dataset, don't make a Stokes cube. Instead combine all LC states for both cameras into a single NB image per tuning, producing a cube similar to that for a data set without polarimetry. (For a nonpolarlimetric dataset, no effect.)

noremove_periodic
nostretch in optional type=boolean

Compute no intrascan stretch vectors if this is set.
